answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock: an agent locks 40 POA and publishes a sonnet-length record of past trades, verses that break if rearranged. A reef of counterparties verifies it: each trade must cross a bridge of 8 verified partners, and any partner can dispute a fake fingerprint, slashing the escrow. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, while each fake earns under 25 POA. An honest agent pays once and earns about 2 POA per epoch.
